name: 17735-longdecode-qwen3-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine on the V1 architecture.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 48 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. That leaves 36 measured requests, each contributing 511 inter-token gaps, so the scored p95 is taken over ~18,000 gaps. The single stream is part of the declaration and does not move upward.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt exactly 256 tokens, output exactly 512 with ignore_eos, so each request is one prefill step against 511 decode steps. Sampling is random -- temperature 1.0, no top_p, no top_k, no seed. Prompts go on the wire raw via `request_format: plain` (the completions-style path, no chat-template wrapper), so the wire prompt is exactly 256 tokens.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant on one GPU, turning short prompts into 512-token drafts from an 8-billion-parameter model.
launch:
# One Qwen3-8B engine on one H100, eager, driven at a single stream.
# max-num-seqs, max-num-batched-tokens and max-model-len are pinned because this engine resolves
# them differently in-process than under `vllm serve`; the resolved value is written down, not
# inferred. Neither binds here -- one stream, 776 tokens of context at most.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Part of the declaration, not a default: no torch.compile warmup, no CUDA-graph capture, no
# shape-bucketed replay, so a per-step time at one stream is a clean reading.
enforce-eager: true

max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# This engine turns prefix caching ON by default; forced off so every request does its own prefill.
enable-prefix-caching: false
